name: marc-tracker
description: M/ARC workout, recovery and coaching tracker (Android/PWA)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/sw-version.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.logo: esbuild src/theme/themes.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/logo-themes.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild src/svg/logo.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/logo-svg.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/render-logo.mjs
scripts.test:tz: TZ=America/New_York vitest run && TZ=Asia/Manila vitest run
